reproducibility_gaps: No software license is present at the pinned repository snapshot.

The README supplies exact core versions but no machine-readable dependency manifest or resolved lock and leaves scienceplots unversioned; ancillary plotting tools import additional undeclared packages.
Current source defaults for the monotonicity-loss weight beta differ by factors of 100 to 4000 from the archived regular-run logs on every dataset.
The paper's monotonicity loss is ReLU of successive predicted-SOH increase, while source multiplies the predicted difference by the observed capacity difference before ReLU.

Only the validation split has a fixed random_state; model initialization, DataLoader shuffling, and other framework randomness are unseeded, and os.listdir ordering controls small-sample selection and TJU partitions.

Only main_XJTU.py executes its regular study directly; other regular, small-sample, comparator-selection, and fine-tuning workflows require uncommenting, changing a hard-coded selector, or explicitly invoking callable functions.
Raw fine-tuning run directories are absent; only source checkpoints and twelve processed source-target workbooks are bundled.
notes: R3 reflects exact documented core versions, complete preprocessed paper datasets, source, training/evaluation logic, eleven source checkpoints, archived regular/small-sample outputs, processed fine-tuning results, and paper targets.

R4 is withheld because exact run/source hyperparameter correspondence, loss-formulation correspondence, deterministic selection/training, direct entrypoints, licensing, and raw transfer outputs are incomplete.
No execution or binary deserialization was performed; R5 remains prohibited.
